resources.string: LightDecoder can list the messages the Messenger app notifies you about, and send your replies through Messenger\'s own Reply button. It never signs in to Messenger or talks to Meta for this.\n\nIt needs notification access. Android then shows LightDecoder every app\'s notifications; only Messenger\'s are read, and what they say stays on this phone.
If Android says the setting is restricted: open LightDecoder\'s App info, tap ⋮, then \"Allow restricted settings\", and try again.

Only what arrived as a notification is listed. Older messages, pictures and new chats are on Facebook\'s page.
The full history needs Android 9 or later. Use the Messenger app instead.

Sign in on Facebook\'s page below. This is Facebook\'s own website in its computer layout: pinch to zoom. Passkeys don\'t work in a web view, so use your password and code. To see end-to-end encrypted chats, Facebook will ask for your PIN or a code.
Check your connection and try again, or open the Messenger app, which is more reliable.
